howto.title: How it works
howto.s1: Search any Pokémon by name or number. Its shiny colours show right away, so you know what to look for.
howto.s2: Every main game from Gold and Silver to Legends: Z-A, with the methods that change the odds: the Shiny Charm, the Masuda method, the Poké Radar, the Friend Safari, chain fishing, the DexNav, SOS chains, Ultra Wormholes, catch combos, Brilliant Pokémon, outbreaks and Sparkling Power.
howto.s3: Tap the big button, or press Space or Enter. Count by 5 for hordes, undo a slip, or type the count in. The timer starts with your first count and works out your encounters per hour.
howto.s4: Found it? Mark it and it joins your trophy case with its encounters, time and date. Found a different shiny first? Save it as a phase and keep going.
howto.odds: Each encounter is checked for a shiny one or more times. The base chance is 1 in 8,192 in Generations 2 to 5 and 1 in 4,096 from X and Y on, and the Shiny Charm and the other methods add more checks. Your chance by now is 1 − (1 − p)ⁿ: after exactly the odds it is about 63%, and it never reaches 100%. Every encounter is a fresh chance, so being past the odds doesn't make the next one likelier.
howto.privacy: Your hunts are saved in this browser, on this device. Nothing is uploaded, and a share link carries only the hunt you share.
